items.title: Dick Griffin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 12, 2024
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer ('[INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe') and the interviewee (Dick Griffin) responds to him. No personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context is described.

ctx.x: Dick was interviewed via Zoom on February 12, 2024 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Dick Griffin with me this morning, not exactly jazz musicians’ hours, but I’m going to introduce you as a trombonist, a composer, and a visual artist, and a very creative person from what I’ve listened to and seen and read. So thanks for joining me.

Thank you for inviting me, and it’s always a pleasure, and believe it or not I’m an early riser. I get up sometimes at 5, 6 and 7 o’clock in the morning. And also I do late nights. So I can stay up ‘til 3 and 4 and 5, whatever, at night, for playing in the nightclubs. So I don’t sleep a lot. I sleep three hours and that’s about it. But I can do it two or three times a day.
